generalFamily.domain: Every n>=4, as well as n=2.

symbolicCentralBlockVerification.finalPhaseEquation: For central-three use negative cosine; for central-four use positive cosine. The remaining compressed J+ equation then vanishes by its defining phase formula.
For central-three use negative cosine; for central-four use positive cosine. The remaining compressed J+ equation then vanishes by its defining phase formula.

generalFamily.remainingOddSizes: For n=6q+1 (q>=1), use the central-three block and outer modules x=11/2+3r. For n=6q+3 (q>=1), use the central-four block and outer modules x=13/2+3r.
generalFamily.integerSpinPrescription: For j=3q or3q+1, include m=0 and modules x=2,5,...,3q-1. For j=3q+2, use modules x=1,4,...,3q+1 and omit m=0.
generalFamily.halfIntegerSpinPrescription: For n=6q+5, use modules x=3/2,9/2,...,3q+3/2 and omit m=0.
generalFamily.scope: This proves existence. Paper maximal-dimension labels remain conjectural unless a separate upper bound matches the dimension.

verification: Every entry is checked symbolically for orthonormality and all k² reduced cross operators at t=1; a t=2 failure is recorded for each whole subspace.
